name: Races, wave 3
notes: Seven crew species: Revenant, Choir, Rattler, Tessellate, Sable, Quillback and Kite (docs/waves/races_2_4.md), each with a homeland region (regions/) and its events (events/). Their traits are bags of keys of the trait library (data/traits.json); the keys revive_once, line_affinity, split_on_death, counter_melee, no_suit and vacuum_speed come from the race3-hooks track. Art is art/crew/<id>/ (claude/art-race3; until it lands the art loader falls back to the human rig; the Tessellate also get tessellate_half for the split). Sidearms are the existing hand weapons (the Choir have none). Recruited at the Prism (Choir) and Rusthold (Rattler, Quillback): data/drift.json; Revenant, Tessellate, Sable and Kite join through events (Revenant at wreck fields, Tessellate at wreck fields, Sable at trader nodes, Kite at empty nodes). Three events per race (events/<race>_events.json: one where the race is the story, two with a blue option for it) and six per homeland (events/<region>_events.json, every one asks for requires.region).
